description: Calculates real-time cryptocurrency swap estimates, accurate network fees, deposit limits, and on-chain routing parameters across 240+ multi-chain pairs. Quotes reflect live FixedFloat liquidity pools and are cached for 30s. Strictly read-only.

amount.description: Positive numeric amount of source cryptocurrency to convert. Precision up to 8 decimal places.

from.description: Source cryptocurrency ticker symbol (case-insensitive, e.g. BTC, XMR, SOL, TON, USDT, ETH, LTC).

to.description: Target cryptocurrency ticker symbol to receive (case-insensitive, e.g. XMR, BTC, USDT, SOL).

name: get_swap_quote
